items.name: dsh-all-usage
items.desc: Analyze usage across models, providers, workspaces, and time ranges — including custom start/end dates over the full retained history — with live cache-hit visibility and separate model and provider breakdowns. Includes hourly single-day trends, daily cross-day trends, a 53-week GitHub-style heatmap, usage streaks, model and workspace Token-share donut charts with Token, cost, and percentage details, independent combinable filters, cache-efficiency trends, DeepSeek account balance, workspace aliases, CSV export, and a durable ledger that preserves successfully flushed usage after session deletion — and after a workspace is deleted, where its recorded usage is summed into one Deleted row — and rebuilds incrementally — on restart, unchanged sessions are applied from the ledger without re-reading their logs (a per-session log revision is the change signal), and only changed/new events are folded. The workspace registry is kept fresh automatically through the DSH domain/changed probe: only added/removed workspaces are reprocessed incrementally, unchanged workspaces reuse their computed aggregates and ledger with zero rescan, and usage is strictly limited to DSH-registered workspaces (unregistered cwds are ignored). After a scan, lightweight revision status fetches full history only when the Host/data state changes and exposes non-sensitive sync health (revision reuse, rereads, ledger recovery, and failures). Token accounting is explicit: input is fresh (cache read/write and reasoning are separate buckets) and zero-usage replays never overwrite recorded usage. Chinese uses local time, English uses UTC; API access is loopback-only.

items.desc: Real-time generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement.

items.name: dsh-liangwengu
items.desc: DeepSeek API pricing reminder with a game HUD: Beijing-time countdowns to peak/off-peak windows, a draggable HP capsule with day/moonlight themes, and a nine-realm cultivation system with breakthrough animations.

items.name: dsh-context-governor
items.desc: Context fullness bands, the per-session compaction threshold derived from the model window, per-step cost computed from cache read and cache write rates, cache-hit, DeepSeek balance with the peak/off-peak tariff, and a one-click handoff. It never calls a model and spends no tokens.

items.name: dsh-gateway-wallet
items.desc: Live remaining balance for the current API key from Sub2API, New API, or official DeepSeek, plus actual spend when the site publishes it, not a local token estimate.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-usage-dash
items.desc: Session usage statistics panel: token and request stats at day/hour/minute granularity, an activity heatmap, bottom-bar session info takeover with per-turn cost chips, and cost estimation under multi-condition time-segmented pricing. Re-implemented from HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel with extensions.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-usage-panel
items.desc: Multi-platform LLM balance and quota panel: configure DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, NewApi or custom endpoints, poll on a schedule, draw balance and quota trend charts, and push threshold and window-reset notices through multiple channels.

items.name: dsh-prompt-templates
items.desc: Global and per-session prompt templates in a right-side panel — insert into the draft or send now, edit, promote session templates to global, with SQLite persistence via the built-in node:sqlite.

items.name: dsh-billing
items.desc: Prices tokens with the official model price table, keeps the per-session and global running cost beside the composer context meter, mirrors your DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar, blocks a turn once this period passes your own global ceiling (clamped to that balance) or a per-session ceiling (each session sets its own, independently), and resets the billing baseline per session or globally — the two are independent, so resetting one never resets the other — so the period goes back to zero while history only rolls into the lifetime total.

items.name: dsh-api-cost
items.desc: Registers an apiCost session projection that estimates DeepSeek spend from reported token usage at published peak / off-peak rates, in CNY and USD, over self, delegation-tree or verified-team scopes: a composer-dock pill and its detail panel, the /cost command, a session_cost tool, and GET routes for the view and the current rate card. A panel switch parks model requests at the llm/stream waterfall while peak rates apply and dispatches them unchanged once the off-peak window opens, so the call is billed at the off-peak rate with no failure reported to the session.

items.name: dsh-plugin-balance-ui
items.desc: Shows DeepSeek account balance and today's token usage in the sidebar footer, and reconciles locally estimated spend against the balance the account actually lost over the days it has sampled.

items.name: dsh-better-stats
items.desc: Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.

items.name: dsh-token-meter-panel
items.desc: Adds a sidebar panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI that reports token usage and cost straight from DeepSeek's own usage API (today's spend, 7/30-day trends, today's hourly split, a history table, cost breakdown, peak/off-peak tier pricing), plus per-session detail from local logs. Zero-config: it reads the browser sign-in for the official figures, and falls back to local session logs with the source labelled.

items.name: dsh-minimax-usage
items.desc: Shows MiniMax Token Plan usage beside the DSH Web UI model selector with compact 5h/7d bars, click-to-refresh, automatic idle and heartbeat refreshes, and endpoint fallback. Reuses subscription keys configured under Settings → Model and appears only for MiniMax Token Plan providers.

items.name: dsh-budget
items.desc: Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions, latency windows, and a carbon-footprint estimate.

items.name: dsh-meow-cachebilling
items.desc: Per-round cache billing inside the composer context-meter popover: what the current call spends on cache hits, misses, and output in CNY, with automatic official peak/off-peak and per-model pricing; hidden on non-official DeepSeek routes.

items.name: dsh-token-stats
items.desc: Token usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI — today/week/month totals, per-model breakdown and a stacked 30-day chart, with a 4-language UI.

items.name: dsh-cost-audit
items.desc: Shows token and CNY cost per turn and per session in the harness's own statistics form, a whole-account bill over 1/7/30-day windows with cost-per-unit-of-work trends, and an advisor that re-measures its own suggestions after you adopt them.

items.name: dsh-personal-center
items.desc: Personal center for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session usage statistics, per-model cost estimation, global custom instructions, a global font-size adjuster, a data-driven desktop pet with bitmap & vector skins, and a conversation status overview, all local and offline.

items.name: dsh-tool-cost-hint
items.desc: Per-turn tool cost line in the chat stream: after each turn a collapsible row under the reply lists which tools ran, how many times, and how many tokens each tool injected into the context (input plus output), expandable to per-tool detail.

items.name: dsh-token-viewer
items.desc: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the dsh web GUI: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero, request-time-bucketed trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak list pricing, per-project and per-model stats, and account balance.

items.name: balance-dsh
items.desc: Shows DeepSeek account balance and current-session token and cost usage in the sidebar footer and composer dock, including peak and off-peak billing and subagent consumption.

items.name: dsh-desktop-statusbar
items.desc: Replaces the stats line under the message input in the DSH desktop app with a configurable status bar of ten optional fields, with live cost estimates at DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates, custom per-model prices, a CNY or USD switch and account balance.

items.name: deepseek-harness-chat-billing
items.desc: DeepSeek account balance, this session's billed spend, and today's total spend in the session-header badge; a turn-cost row in the message actions strip, a detail panel with per-model pricing and a today session-spend ranking. Official peak/off-peak pricing; balance from the real /user/balance API.

items.name: dsh-balance
items.desc: Real-time DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer with a 5-day spending chart.

items.name: dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go
items.desc: Realtime token counter beside the deep-thinking indicator in chat, with merged or split input/output display, per-step operation counts, and auto-scaling K/M/G/T units.

items.name: dsh-key-manager
items.desc: Manage multiple API keys per provider in Settings → API 密钥: keep a pool of keys with notes, switch the active key with one click, and the switch really takes effect on the next model call.

items.name: dsh-minato
items.desc: Optional read-only bridge plugin that publishes live dsh session and token statistics as one JSON snapshot for the standalone dsh-minato toolkit to read.

items.name: dsh-abacus
items.desc: Buckets every model call by local date, provider and model, then shows the totals in a sidebar card, a per-chat pill under the composer and a settings page, alongside each provider's account balance and subscription windows.

items.name: dsh-per-request-cost
items.desc: Composer pill with the DeepSeek account balance, the live peak/off-peak pricing phase, and this session's spend priced request by request at the rate in effect when each request was sent. Subagent sessions' costs are aggregated into the parent session; Search and Fetch fees are charged only for DeepSeek's search engine, while third-party engines (Tavily, Bing, Exa, …) are counted but free. The balance refresh interval is configurable.

items.name: dsh-token-saver
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggressively saves tokens without affecting task quality: lossless head/tail truncation of tool results (default), grep-result folding, pressure-triggered dsh-compaction-basic delegation, and an LLM-summary CompactionEngine subclass for the aggressive mode. Saves 97.6% of input tokens on an 8-scenario synthetic suite, with all reductions routed through dsh event flow so model-visible = logged stays intact.

items.name: dsh-balance-monitor
items.desc: Shows selectable DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, and TeamoRouter balances in the DSH Web sidebar, with per-provider details, usage data, and refresh controls.

items.name: dsh-platform-usage#plugin
items.desc: Account-level DeepSeek platform usage inside the DSH settings page — 52-week token heatmap, per-API-key and per-model breakdown, live balance.

items.name: dsh-thinking-token-stat
items.desc: A lightweight plugin that adds model thinking token statistics to the bottom Dock.

items.name: dsh-usage-dash-board
items.desc: Cross-session usage rollup that resolves opaque route keys to real model names, with a per-request log, an editable four-bucket price table that leaves unknown models unpriced instead of guessing, and a calendar-day-filled bar trend whose values appear only on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: dsh-agent-token-stats
items.desc: Cross-agent token usage dashboard: aggregates local conversation logs from Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor IDE, DSH, OpenClaw, CodeWhale, Hermes and more into a persistent ledger that survives log deletion, with cache-hit rate, cost estimation, period comparison and day drill-down analytics in a sidebar panel.

items.name: dsh-rub-cost
items.desc: Session cost in rubles in the composer dock — the tariff in effect with its countdown, the API cost at that tariff, the CBR rate, the total including subagents, cache savings, and DeepSeek Platform balances.

items.name: dsh-plugin-ds-balance
items.desc: DeepSeek API balance + per-call cost tracker: durable per-call cost ledger from real usage chunks with official Beijing peak/off-peak (x2) pricing, 60 s balance polling, and a sidebar footer action showing balance and today's spend.

items.name: dsh-plugins#balance
items.desc: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer plus spend per session, today, this month and all time, priced by a configurable time-of-day price table per currency (DeepSeek CNY/USD defaults included). Two read-only remote methods, no host routes, key read through the host credentials seam on every call, egress only to the configured provider origin.

items.name: dsh--prompt--enhance
items.desc: Prompt enhancer for the DSH web UI with basic/standard/expert modes: standard/expert modes rewrite drafts with project context and recent session history, retry gracefully when gateways reject reasoning-effort settings, and show a before/after review with undo.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-status
items.desc: DeepSeek account wallet balance and the current peak or off-peak billing period, in a fixed status region at the sidebar foot, with a manual refresh and an official top-up link.

items.name: dsh-coding-plan-quota
items.desc: Quota ring beside the DSH model selector that reads OpenCode Go and 14 other coding-plan quotas or balances, cycles the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and colours itself by urgency.

items.name: dsh-usage-state
items.desc: Shows the account balance or coding-plan quota (5h/7d/30d) of the provider behind the current model, on its own line above the composer input; display only, no cost accounting.

items.name: dsh-usage-mini
items.desc: Floating usage window for DSH Web showing Claude and Codex subscription windows with reset countdowns, plus DeepSeek API spend and balance; display-only companion to dsh-cost-meter.

items.name: dsh-offpeak
items.desc: Holds DeepSeek model calls for the rest of each peak-hour window you configure instead of sending them, so they are billed at off-peak rates; also pauses active goals while it waits and shows the account balance with an 8-hour spend chart.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-usage
items.desc: Shows the DeepSeek account balance as a row in the sidebar footer with a refresh button, and opens a popover with the balance card, daily token and estimated-cost charts over a 7/30-day window, a per-model table, and a link to the platform usage page. The balance comes from the official /user/balance endpoint; usage is aggregated from local DSH session logs and priced with the published peak/off-peak rate card in CNY, so it is labelled an estimate and its scope is stated on the panel.

items.name: dsh-musage
items.desc: Shows coding-plan usage and balance for 5 AI providers (MiniMax, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, Zhipu) beside the composer input, switching with the selected model and reusing API keys configured in DSH model settings.

items.name: deepseek-harness-wallet-patched
items.desc: Maintained fork of feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center, which has not been updated since 2026-09-09. Pricing follows the official model pool instead of a hardcoded model prefix, so DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (`deepseek-flash`) is billed and shows its peak/off-peak clock, and the official price page is parsed structurally so a renamed or retired model no longer stops price sync. Adds an English interface beside the original Chinese. Otherwise the same plugin: balance, per-session cost and token breakdown, a 24-hour peak/off-peak clock, Z.ai plan quota, and a local usage ledger, following the host light/dark theme.

items.name: dsh-otel
items.desc: Exports the agent loop to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, with seven Grafana dashboards covering token usage, cost, session outcomes and per-turn latency.

items.name: just-dsh-plugins#dsh-auto-update
items.desc: One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.

items.name: dsh-toolkit#dsh-api-balance
items.desc: Shows DeepSeek API balance and per-turn conversation cost directly in the session UI.

items.name: deepseek-harness-session-cost-pill
items.desc: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
items.desc: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, optionally alongside the DeepSeek account balance; a hover popover lists each window with its reset countdown, and a minimal mode nests the rings. Settings cover refresh interval, progress basis, what the pill shows and its position.

items.name: dsh-cache-hit-precision
items.desc: Refines the built-in cache-hit percentage to three decimals in place across the composer stats row and the token-usage dialog.

items.name: dsh-aliyun-balance
items.desc: Floating one-line widget showing how much Alibaba Cloud credit is left (voucher balance + account balance), with voucher face value, used amount and earliest expiry on hover. Read-only BSS queries, no spend tracking.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
items.desc: Plan-usage pet for the DSH web GUI: a floating skeletal-animated character reports quota in a speech bubble, auto-matching the configured provider (OpenCode Go, Command Code, DeepSeek) to show a plan percentage or an account balance, and falling back to local token stats when the provider API is unavailable; draggable, wheel-scalable (90-260px), synthesized click sounds, loopback-only routes.

items.name: dsh-composer-tokens
items.desc: Real-time token estimates for the DSH conversation composer, combining the current context baseline with the draft and showing exact or heuristic counts.

items.name: dsh#tally
items.desc: Per-request cost ledger covering retries and subagents, holiday-aware peak/off-peak pricing, shared pricing/usage/balance/budget services, and DeepSeek bill reconciliation.

items.name: dsh#tally-ui
items.desc: Cost readouts for the composer, turns and sessions, a usage dashboard, daily/monthly budgets and settings, with DeepSeek balance from dsh-tally-balance-deepseek.

items.name: dsh-turn-cost
items.desc: Per-turn and per-session estimated cost in the DSH Web UI, computed from provider-reported token usage in four buckets with the built-in official DeepSeek CNY peak/off-peak card — peak hours are Monday-Friday 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time, weekends and Chinese statutory holidays are off-peak all day. An optional local JSON rate table overlays prices for other or self-hosted models, and models without a price show tokens only.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-quota
items.desc: OpenCode Go quota in the sidebar foot under the workspace list: one cell for the most constrained window plus a hover popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly percents, each with a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker, the remaining share and a reset countdown, refreshed every 60 seconds from OpenCode's official usage API using the key already in the DSH credential store.

items.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-provider-usage
items.desc: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.

items.name: dsh-cost-gauge
items.desc: Peak/off-peak billing cost dial for the DSH Web GUI: session token usage billed at the official DeepSeek peak and off-peak rates, a rate dial with a model-colored needle and switch countdown, a balance ring with a low-balance alarm, drag-to-resize, and a minimized status-lamp mode.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-cpa-quota
items.desc: CLIProxyAPI quota for DeepSeek Harness: a ring beside the model picker plus a settings panel listing every account quota windows with plans and reset times.

items.name: dsh-token-cost
items.desc: Live token usage and estimated cost in the sidebar: the current task plus every session combined, an as-of clock for those totals, per-session time detail (elapsed, turns/steps, first-token, model vs tool time, decode speed), and a per-turn breakdown with each turn cost on hover.

items.name: dsh-token-live
items.desc: Composer readouts for the DeepSeek Harness: CJK-weighted draft token count, session spend at official peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and what the same usage would have cost on the costliest other model; client-only, with no host half and no credential access.

items.name: dsh-usage-dashboard
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness usage analytics dock on the composer: Beijing-time peak/valley pricing with all-day weekend valley rate, live balance, cross-session history, by-date drill-down and charts.

items.name: dsh-damage-pulse
items.desc: Tracks DeepSeek token usage, per-call and session costs, and account balance with cache-aware charge animations in the DSH Web UI.

items.name: dsh-api-balance
items.desc: Live DeepSeek API balance and this session's token usage in the conversation header, with a detail panel for the topped-up / granted balance split, request count, input, output and cache-hit tokens, and context pressure. The API key is read on every query and is never cached, written to disk or returned to the browser.

items.name: dsh-token-usage-xc
items.desc: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness - today's token consumption by model, cache hit rate, 7-day trend chart, optional header badge, persistent storage with auto cleanup.

items.name: dsh-usage-suite
items.desc: Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.

items.name: dsh-usage-stats
items.desc: Token usage statistics by model, session and date in a sidebar panel, plus OpenCode Go quota, DeepSeek balance and Z.ai quota monitoring.

items.name: dsh-clear-usage
items.desc: Local Token usage dashboard in DSH Settings with hourly activity, daily heatmaps, custom date ranges, model breakdowns, local/API filters, and native cache-hit accounting, without cost estimates or composer overrides. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.

items.name: dsh-tide-badge
items.desc: Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.

items.name: dsh-token-usage-ledger
items.desc: Persistent token-usage ledger and Web Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-token-plan-quota
items.desc: Balance badge that follows the active model provider: official readings for DeepSeek, Qwen Token Plan and Aliyun BSS, plus Moonshot and OpenRouter endpoints not yet key-verified.

items.name: dsh-smart-scenario-router
items.desc: Routes dsh requests by conversation scenario and retries with fallback models when requests fail.

items.name: dsh-cpa-status
items.desc: CPA account-pool status panel: sidebar health light, quota bars, success-rate ticks, and gateway key endings.

items.name: dsh-service-monitor
items.desc: Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-cost-live
items.desc: Real-time DeepSeek API balance (official endpoint) and today-spend estimate (this DSH instance session-log usage x per-model price table) for the DSH web: composer dock strip, always-on floating badge, full settings dashboard (7-day trend, per-model cost, editable price table and polling, history rescan). The API key never leaves the host.

items.name: dsh-prompt-lab
items.desc: Agent-structured prompt optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites composer drafts into role/task/context/constraint/format with normal, slim, and expand modes, a confirm modal with score, continue-optimize, and local, hybrid, DSH, or cloud-API engines.

items.name: dsh-token-frugal
items.desc: Cuts session input tokens three ways, each with its own switch in a panel under the composer: lossless structure-aware compression of tool results on `tools/post-execute`, then a per-tool head/tail elision that always names a recovery path through the shared spill store; tool-catalogue visibility per agent on `agent/created`; and a per-workspace memory document that recall matches against each new message and injects through `agent.inject`, so the transcript is not re-read. Measured 41.76% fewer prompt tokens over 149 recorded requests, with a bundled script that re-measures any profile.

items.name: dsh-output-setting
items.desc: Auto-expand reasoning and tool cards, tune code-block font size and line spacing, and choose the model output language (auto, Chinese or English).

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugins#token-meter
items.desc: Unified token quota and usage statistics for dsh: multi-vendor rolling/payg quota with sidebar cards and provider ops, plus session-log token aggregation with trends, heatmap, and per-model breakdown.

items.name: dsh-float
items.desc: Floating DeepSeek API balance capsule for the DSH Web GUI: a corner pill shows the remaining balance, clicking expands the total, granted and topped-up breakdown, double-clicking refreshes at once and the balance polls every 5 seconds; the host half proxies /user/balance so the key never reaches the browser.

items.name: dsh-balance-display
items.desc: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage statistics with historical backfill, and GitHub version auto-check.

items.name: dsh-token-attention
items.desc: Token attention management panel for DeepSeek Harness: per-task/day/week/month token usage and cost tracking (input hit/miss, output, reasoning), DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, task-type recognition, and advice on when to switch sessions, write a hand-off, or compact context.

items.name: dsh-usage-heatmap
items.desc: Token usage dashboard in the DSH settings page: nine metric cards (total, today, yesterday, peak day, longest session, active-day streak, active days, sessions, subagent tokens), a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, and an activity insight list, aggregated locally from session logs and projection caches, keeping token history after a session is deleted.

items.name: deepseek-cost-usage-status-plugin
items.desc: Adds a colored status line under the DSH conversation stats showing live DeepSeek API cost, usage and account balance, with on/off-peak pricing indicators.

items.name: headroom-stats-plugin
items.desc: Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.

items.name: llmtrim-stats-plugin
items.desc: Live llmtrim savings dashboard in the DSH web UI: Settings page with paid, would-have-cost, saved-today and saved-this-week cards plus per-model breakdown, and a configurable rotating or static stats strip under the composer.

items.name: dsh-usage-orb
items.desc: Cross-session usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on usage ring plus a draggable panel that aggregates token usage, cache-hit rate, cost and balance from local session logs, with per-tool cost attribution, iOS-style tile layout editing and an optional animated companion face.

items.name: dsh-mini-usage
items.desc: Local token totals, per-model usage and a 12-week heatmap in a Chinese sidebar panel.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-balance
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.

items.name: dsh-balance-meter
items.desc: Reads the API balance or subscription quota behind the current DSH route — including OpenDesign (AMR) wallet and Design Plan windows via the control plane — and never guesses a figure: a miss reports its cause (the raw response is echoed only when parsing fails). OpenDesign needs `vela login` or a desktop `controlKey` in `~/.amr/config.json`.

items.name: ai-token-report#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.

items.name: dsh-call-shrink
items.desc: Extreme LLM-call compression for DeepSeek Harness: title short-circuit, in-flight dedup, 24h replay cache, and batch-merging N parallel requests into 1 upstream call via a `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` delimiter protocol - fewer API calls, less spend, same answers.

items.name: dsh-budget-handoff
items.desc: Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff snapshot so the next session can continue the work.

items.name: dsh-token-optimizer
items.desc: Token-cost pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: pressure-aware layered compaction (lossless projection below 40% context pressure, LLM summarization above), per-agent tool allowlisting, long-text-to-image with vision summarization, and a /token-status command tracking pressure, tiers, and saved tokens.

items.name: dsh-commandcode-usage
items.desc: CommandCode usage & balance panel for DeepSeek Harness: API usage, credit balance, 5-hour/weekly windows from the sidebar footer.
